# 获取faceliveness的配置
##### 简要描述

- | 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| Enable | boolean | 是否使能人脸活体检测；false-否，true-是 | 是 |
| Score | float | 活体检测阈值,[0-100] | 是 |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
GET /FaceRecognition/FaceLivenessStatus HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: 38a7ebbf-69f1-49b5-9102-4ff55c04ddf9
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Length:145
Content-Type:application/xml
Connection:close

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<FaceLivenessStatus Version="1.0">
<Enable>true</Enable>
<Score>50</Score>
</FaceLivenessStatus>
```

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceRecognition/FaceLivenessStatus` 

##### 请求方式

- get
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
[]

```
